phrase.zh: 电与磁，在同一场中相遇。
phrase.en: Electricity and magnetism meet in one field.

visual.zh: 人物身后的红蓝曲线相互缠绕，给电场、磁场和传播中的波形以统一形象。曲线并不是麦克斯韦方程的数值解。
visual.en: Red and blue curves weave behind a stylized figure to join electric fields, magnetic fields and a traveling wave. They are not a numerical solution to Maxwell’s equations.

background.zh: 麦克斯韦把电与磁的规律组织成场的理论，并指出变化的电磁场能够以波传播，光也是电磁波。无线电与可见光属于同一电磁谱，但有不同的频率和波长。
background.en: Maxwell organized the laws of electricity and magnetism into a field theory and showed that changing fields can propagate as waves, including light. Radio and visible light belong to one electromagnetic spectrum, at different frequencies and wavelengths.
